message.content: {"caption":"Line chart of mean accuracy across agent iterations, with a best-accuracy reference line and a shaded 95% confidence interval.","description":"The chart is titled “AIME and GPQA Show Little Improvement.” The x-axis is Agent Iteration, from 0 to 9; the y-axis is Mean Accuracy, with labeled ticks at 0.65, 0.70, 0.75, and 0.80 (the plotted range is approximately 0.60–0.85). The blue Mean Accuracy line fluctuates: it rises slightly from about 0.75 at iteration 0 to a peak near 0.76 at 2, falls to about 0.69 at 4, rebounds to about 0.76 at 5, dips again near 0.69 at 6, rises to about 0.75 at 7, then ends around 0.70 at iterations 8–9. The red Best Mean Accuracy So Far line is horizontal at about 0.76 throughout. A pale-blue shaded 95% Confidence Interval surrounds the mean line; its upper and lower edges vary across iterations and are widest around iterations 4, 6, 8, and 9. Five callouts point to the curve: “Independent math verifier” has a downward arrow at iteration 1, near the red line; “Sympy symbolic calculator” has an upward arrow at iteration 2; “Math cross-validator” has an upward arrow at iteration 4; “Geometry specialist” has a downward arrow at iteration 5; and “Systematic mathematical reasoning” has an upward arrow at iteration 6.
